# WordPress.com

> WordPress.com is an all-in-one website building platform combining managed hosting, AI-powered site creation, e-commerce tools, and professional services for individuals and agencies.

WordPress.com provides a complete ecosystem for website creation and management, from domain registration and hosting to AI-assisted design and newsletter platforms. The service caters to bloggers, small businesses, e-commerce sellers, and agencies with tiered pricing and white-label solutions.

## Key Topics

- Website Builder
- AI Website Builder
- Managed WordPress Hosting
- E-commerce Platform
- Domain Registration
- WordPress Themes
- Newsletter Platform
- Professional Email
- WordPress Patterns
- Automattic
- Website Design Service
- WordPress Plugins
- Site Creation
- Commerce Solutions
- Agency Tools

## Core Products & Platform

- [WordPress.com: Everything You Need to Build Your Website](https://wordpress.com): WordPress.com homepage: website builder with hosting, themes, and tools
- [Website Builder | Create Your Site With WordPress | Start Here | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/website-builder): WordPress.com website builder with drag-and-drop and 1000+ themes
- [AI Website Builder | Create a WordPress.com Site in Minutes](https://wordpress.com/ai-website-builder): AI-powered website builder generating layouts and content in minutes
- [Explore WordPress.com Features | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/features): WordPress.com features overview: customization, hosting, and support

## Hosting & Domain Services

- [Managed WordPress Hosting | Speed & Security With No Limits | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/hosting): Managed WordPress hosting with built-in speed, security, and reliability
- [Domain Name Search | Find Your WordPress.com Domain Now](https://wordpress.com/domains): Domain registration and search for WordPress.com websites
- [Get a Professional Email Address | Free 3-month Trial | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/professional-email): Professional email service with 3-month free trial via Google Apps

## Content & Commerce Solutions

- [Ecommerce Website Builder | Build Online Stores with WordPress | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/ecommerce): E-commerce website builder for online stores with payment processing
- [Create Your Blog With The Best Blogging Platform | Start Free | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/create-blog): Free blog creation platform with WordPress.com hosting included
- [WordPress Newsletter: Your newsletter's forever home | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/newsletter): WordPress newsletter platform with creator-first pricing and audience control

## Pricing & Plans

- [WordPress.com Pricing | Find the Perfect Plan for Your Site](https://wordpress.com/pricing): WordPress.com pricing plans with hosting, domains, and security bundled

## Business & Agency Programs

- [Grow Your WordPress Business with Automattic for Agencies | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/for-agencies): Automattic for Agencies program: agency pricing, support, and tools
- [WordPress Website Design Service | WordPress.com](https://wordpress.com/website-design-service): Expert website design services starting at $499 with customization
- [Grow Your Income as a WordPress.com Affiliate](https://wordpress.com/affiliates): WordPress.com affiliate program with up to 100% payouts
